lens: all three in turn (learning-scientist, examiner, learner-advocate); scores are the combined view

lens_notes.learning-scientist: Probes precede explanations (S1.gate, S2.entry, S3.shock_case, S5.wx2). Wrong options carry refutation plus re-test in other forms (TR1, TR3, TR16). Weak: a correct-answer node (S5.t1_c_ok) re-licenses the trap it should refute, so the retrieval loop for TR1 breaks. Repetition across S1/S3/S4/S5/S8 is drill, not spaced retrieval.
lens_notes.examiner: Trap set is exam-shaped (TR3 halving errors, TR6 child rule of nines, TR12/TR13 inhalation tests, TR27 antidote pairs). Precision fails on the fluid rule: S5.t1_ok and S5.t1_c_ok say 2 mL is current practice and then the exam key stays 4 mL with no qualifier, and S6.start calls 700 mL/h the formula's starting rate. An examiner cannot tell which figure the module carries.
lens_notes.learner-advocate: A tired student at 1 a.m. meets 12 airway/shock/Parkland repeats, 'Sure of this? Skip the why' labels, 'Ravi's revision list' with no setup (S7.cold), and 'That is not right' on a correct HF pairing (S7.spot_t1). Two of four simulated walks hit the 220-step cap before END. Warm where it counts (S1.gate_t29 sure_note, S5.wx2_ok).

gate_notes: No G3 or G4 failure found. Four simulated walks reached nodes via next fields; novice and guesser hit the 220-step cap, not a dead end. Unverified: S2.p7_ok continues to S2.p4 (strong sim); a loop is possible if reached in another order, not walked.

criteria_notes.R1: Probe-first is the norm in S1, S2, S3, S4 and S6. S5.wx1 and S5.d_recap are explanation runs. Score 4.
criteria_notes.R2: Every wrong option maps to a trap in module.json with error_type. Feedback names the wrong model ('Model: ... You may have corrected it on the spot') and re-tests on a later node. Deductions: S5.t1_c_ok re-licenses TR1; S3.colloid_probe labels a 5% dextrose option as TR8 although dextrose is not a colloid (strong sim); S7.spot_t1 gives 'not right' on the correct pairing.
criteria_notes.R3: All 11 objectives are taught or tested on the strong path. Novice and guesser walks reached no END, so coverage on every path is not confirmed; O9 is reached only in S7 and S8 and drops on skip paths (S7.a1_ok skips S7.q3).
criteria_notes.R4: Several nodes break the 60-word, one-idea rule: S5.d_recap (five rules in two sentences), S2.co_ok (half-life figures plus a third idea), S7.a1_t0 (convoluted), S3.depth_ok and S4.child_chart (three messages each).
criteria_notes.R5: Fast lanes (S1.gate_ok, S2.entry_ok, S4.case_ok, S7.start_ok skip), hint ladder (S1.gate_hint), Try again and Show me the working. Weak: skip labels read as doubting confidence, and skips drop content silently.
criteria_notes.R6: PYQ-style vignettes and traps explicit (TR3 with 1,400, 233 and partial 350 at S5.wx2; TR27 antidote pairs). Pulled down by the unresolved 2 mL vs 4 mL key (S5.t1_ok, S5.t1_c_ok, S6.start, S5.d_recap).
criteria_notes.R7: Real moments: house fire airway (S1.gate), 2-year-old TBSA (S4.child_q), ambulance pre-hospital fluid (S6.ambulance), escharotomy in a constricted limb (S6.escharotomy). Score 4.
criteria_notes.R8: Warm 'You were sure...' sure_notes and calm reframing of errors in the report. Flat or odd lines: 'Ravi's revision list' (S7.cold), 'Sure of this? Skip the why' (S7.start_ok), 'Show me the answer' exits with no retest.
criteria_notes.R9: Path separates Sure, Guessing and retry (sim verdicts differ: misconceived overconfident, guesser weak, strong calibrated). Report accuracy is the drag: see review.segments and personas below.

novice.accurate: Headline weak and the guess pattern (guess_right 11, sure_wrong 0) match the walk. The 'fell_open' status and 'gap' on 10 of 11 objectives ignore corrections made on retry, so the report says the learner believes less than the walk shows.
novice.wrong_or_unhelpful: hints: 3 but the walk took one hint; TR17 reported fell_open though it was only met at S8.p9_t1 and never tested; card 2 (electrical urine target in mL/kg/h) is not answerable from the path.

misconceived.accurate: Mixed headline and overconfident calibration with 30 sure errors match the walk (TR1 at S5.t1_try, S7.a1).
misconceived.wrong_or_unhelpful: All 11 objectives read 'shaky' though all 20 traps were recovered on retry, so the 'redo all 18 cards' instruction is over-broad. The report does not tell this learner that the remaining belief is TR1 via S5.t1_c_ok.

strong.accurate: Headline strong, calibrated, fast_lane true, hints 0 are all correct.
strong.wrong_or_unhelpful: Praises TBSA as secure with 'switch to child proportions or Lund and Browder' though the child figures were skipped (S4.close_ok, S4.child_chart). Parkland is called secure though the fluid figure is unclear (S5.t1_c_ok). Card holes for Lund and Browder (card 4) and Brooke vs Evans (card 7) are not named.

guesser.accurate: Weak headline and the first-try pattern fit.
guesser.wrong_or_unhelpful: Every trap is reported fell_open, including TR3, TR14, TR16-TR19, TR22 and TR29, which were never offered on this walk. Objectives include depth and urine targets that were corrected on retry. Retry text 'not on a later question' is untrue for ideas that came back. This is a render defect, not a learner finding.

segments.reason: S1.gate is a good probe: a house-fire airway vignette, one correct option, TR29 and TR30 traps, and a hint node. Airway returns at S1.final, S8.p1 and S8.p12, which is more than the spacing needs.
S2.entry, S2.p4 and S2.err_step carry real traps (TR12, TR13, TR27), and the 'right test' ladder is clear. S2.co_ok packs half-life numbers and a third idea into a correct-answer node.

S3.colloid_probe labels a 5% dextrose option as TR8 when dextrose is not a colloid (strong sim). S3.shock_case repeats at S5.d_try with near-identical clues. S3.depth_ok runs three messages and the third loses the learner.

S4.child_q is a good child-TBSA probe, but it is asked again at S6.tb_vig and S6.child_tbsa. S4.adult_chart says 'eighteens for the trunk sides and legs' without saying front or back. S4.close_ok skips the child chart for fast-lane learners.

S5.t1_c_ok says 'Yes. About 2 mL' then 'with no qualifier the exam answer stays 4 mL'. The stem (S5.t1_try) cites current ATLS practice. Every walk flagged this (novice, misconceived, strong, guesser). A correct-answer node restores TR1, the module's highest-yield trap. The S5.wx2 probe is well built: 700 correct, with 1,400 (TR3), 233 (TR3) and a partial 350 (S5.wx2_part). Fix the fluid rule first.

S6.start calls 700 mL/h 'the formula's starting rate' after S5 used 2 mL for current practice, so the fluid figure conflicts again. S6.drip repeats S5.c_seq (subtract fluid given). S6.me_partial treats a partial answer as 'not right' with only Try again or Show me.

S7.spot_t1 says 'That choice is not right. That order pairs the poison with its own antidote', which reads as a rebuke of a correct pairing (misconceived sim). S7.a1_ok skips S7.q3 so Brooke vs Evans is never shown. S7.cold introduces 'Ravi's revision list' with no setup. S7.q6 and S7.c2 repeat the Curling vs Marjolin ask.

Twelve probes S8.p1 to S8.p12 re-ask airway, depth, TBSA and topicals already taught in S1 to S7. Novice and guesser walks hit the 220-step cap before END (S8.p9 and S8.p3). Strong walk reached END in 115 steps. Consolidation becomes drill for everyone who did not skip.

best_parts: node S5.wx2: 700 mL/h key with 1,400 (TR3, whole 24 h into 8 h), 233 (TR3, half over 24 h) and partial 350 (S5.wx2_part). Each distractor is one error, and the feedback names the wrong model.
node S1.gate: house-fire vignette, correct airway first, TR29 and TR30 traps, a hint node, and ask_confidence set.
node S1.gate_t29 sure_note: 'You were sure, so look at this one again: the sum is never the first move.' Names the error without rebuke and points to the primary survey.
node S5.wx2_ok and S1.gate_ok: correct feedback says why the answer is right (halve the total, divide by window), per DP13.
flaws: node S5.t1_c_ok: correct-answer node that restores TR1 after it was refuted (all four walks).
node S7.spot_t1: 'That choice is not right' attached to the correct pairing; the second line reads as praise.
node S3.colloid_probe: 5% dextrose option labelled TR8 though dextrose is not a colloid, so the trap label does not match the wrong model.
node S7.cold: 'Ravi's revision list' names a person nobody set up.
node S7.a1_ok and S4.close_ok: fast-lane skips drop content silently (Brooke vs Evans, child chart), and the report then praises those skills as secure.
node S5.d_recap: five rules in two long sentences; split into one idea per node.
node S8.p1 to S8.p12: repeats of S1 to S7 vignettes; cut to one new vignette per objective.
report (render-report): trap statuses default to fell_open for untested traps (guesser), and hints count is wrong (novice).
merge_ideas: Fix the fluid rule once in S5.t1_ok and S5.t1_c_ok, then use the same figure in S5.wx1, S6.start and S5.d_recap. This single change lifts R6 and R2 most.
Keep S5.wx2's three-distractor build (TR3 variants with partial credit) and apply it to S6.start and S8 instead of re-asking the same vignettes.
Use S1.gate's probe-hint-refute pattern for the S4 child TBSA node, so the age trap is met once with a hint before the explanation.
Replace S8.p1 to S8.p12 with one interleaved vignette per cluster (airway plus depth, shock plus fluid), so retrieval spans objectives and length falls below the 220-step cap.
module_actions: Blocking: rewrite S5.t1_c_ok and S5.t1_ok so the fluid figure is stated once with its qualifier.
Blocking: fix the report renderer so untested traps are not reported as fell_open and retry recoveries are credited.
Cut S8 to about six probes and remove repeated vignettes, so a novice reaches END within the cap.
Relabel the fast-lane skip buttons to plain wording and show the content each skip drops in the report's skip text.
